= Engine module map

Every module of the simulation engine and its purpose (the first paragraph of its docstring).

== How one run moves through the modules

An arrow is a run-time import (the scheduler, which almost every module imports, is left out).
The cascade and the driver keep method groups in their own modules (`cascade_*`, `kickoff`) as
functions bound into the class.

[mermaid]
....
flowchart TD
    block_lifecycle --> block_env
    costs --> load
    driver --> costs
    driver --> kickoff
    driver --> load
    driver --> orchestrator
    kickoff --> block_env
    kickoff --> block_lifecycle
    kickoff --> costs
    kickoff --> orchestrator
    orchestrator --> cascade_cold
    orchestrator --> cascade_dependency
    orchestrator --> cascade_phase
    orchestrator --> cascade_status
    orchestrator --> load
    runner --> driver
    runner --> load
    step_session --> driver
    step_session --> orchestrator
....

== Modules

[cols="3,8",options="header"]
|===
| Module | Purpose
| `raptor/core/engine/accounting.py` | Per-block accounting on a state change (split out of `blocks.change_block_state`).
| `raptor/core/engine/block_env.py` | What an ordinary block's process needs from the rest of the run.
| `raptor/core/engine/block_lifecycle.py` | A block's lifecycle: `RBDBlockObj.Run`/`Repair`/`PerformPM` as one process.
| `raptor/core/engine/blocks.py` | Port of `RBDBlockObj.ChangeBlockState` and the "block has failed" log line from `DetermineNewState`.
| `raptor/core/engine/capacity.py` | Capacity analysis -- ports of:
| `raptor/core/engine/cascade.py` | Ports the two dispatchers that turn a state-change's deltas into a downstream update: `RBDBlockObj.ReconfigureBlock` (block -> node) and the cascade tail of `ChangeNodeState` (node -> node, for multi-hop topologies like `join -> end`).
| `raptor/core/engine/cascade_cold.py` | The cascade's cold-standby handling: running `ColdLogic` when a cold-standby node's paths change, interrupting switches in flight, and flushing the changed-cold group (`CheckColds`).
| `raptor/core/engine/cascade_dependency.py` | The cascade's dependency dispatch: delivering a depended-upon object's change to its dependent blocks (`BackFlowDependencies`), with source's `IF FailWait ... ELSIF ZeroWait` delivery gate, and `ResendBackFlow`.
| `raptor/core/engine/cascade_phase.py` | The cascade's phase change: `ConductPhaseChange`, applying a new phase's stress, Cut/Linked state and node paths to every phased block, event and node, in source's order.
| `raptor/core/engine/cascade_status.py` | The cascade's system status: the deferred end-of-instant `AnalyzeSystem` check, the capacity-only re-analysis, and the end of the simulation (`CallEndSimulation` / `EndSimulation`).
| `raptor/core/engine/cold_standby.py` | Port of `RBDNodeObj`'s cold-standby switching group: `IdAndSortColds` (link priority sort) and `RunColdLogic` (the K-of-N group-switching engine).
| `raptor/core/engine/costs.py` | A run's cost tables (`Cost Analysis`).
| `raptor/core/engine/cumulative.py` | The "Cumulative By Trial" file (Avant-garde "Cumulative Params by Trial", `RamInterval`): Raptor 7's header row and `CalculateInterimRams` (a row after every run whose number is a multiple of the interval).
| `raptor/core/engine/data_files.py` | The four per-run data files of Simulation Options > Files & Reports.
| `raptor/core/engine/dependency.py` | Port of `RBDBlockObj.BackFlowDependencies`'s deterministic subset and the dispatch guard that decides when to call it, from `ReconfigureBlock` -- plus `repair_completion_status`, a second, independent dependency mechanism from `DetermineNewState`'s "Maintenance Completed" handler (see its docstring).
| `raptor/core/engine/diststats.py` | Distribution statistics -- port of `ComputeStats` in Raptor 7, used by the 'Update Statistics' display (Mean / Standard Deviation labels under each distribution's parameter fields) and by the Empirical Data dialog.
| `raptor/core/engine/domain_tree.py` | `DomainTree.TXT` and `CoreFile.TXT` -- Raptor 7's two developer-only walks over the EFPA graph from the End node (`CreateDomainTree`, `WriteDomains`, `WriteCores`, Avant-garde boxes "Domain Tree" and "Core File").
| `raptor/core/engine/driver.py` | One replication: build the run context and drive a run from kickoff to its report.
| `raptor/core/engine/errors.py` | Engine exceptions and invariant helpers.
| `raptor/core/engine/eventlog.py` | Shared event-log line formatting -- port of `WriteEvents`.
| `raptor/core/engine/events.py` | Port of `RBDEventObj.ConductEvent`/`ChangeEventState`.
| `raptor/core/engine/fev.py` | Failure Effects View (FEV): a model state you change by hand, with no event loop.
| `raptor/core/engine/fmeca.py` | The Failure Effects text: `CreateFMECAarray` and `WriteFMECAtoFile`.
| `raptor/core/engine/graph.py` | Scoped port of `RunEFPA`'s structural-graph-building loops: given a loaded `.rbd` file's parsed `LINK_DATA`, derive each node's `in_paths_array`/`propagates_to_node_ids`/`propagates_to_link_ids` and each block/event's `downstream_link_id`.
| `raptor/core/engine/interrupts.py` | Interrupt reasons: the values of MODSIM's `InterruptReason` that the engine sends with `Scheduler.interrupt` and dispatches on when a wait is cut short.
| `raptor/core/engine/invariants.py` | Runtime invariants of a simulation, checked after every scheduler step.
| `raptor/core/engine/kickoff.py` | A run's kickoff (`SingleRunDriver.kickoff`), in source's order: reset the run, initialize every block and event, build the pools, start every process, then the triggers and the System's own activities. Also the callbacks those phases hand to processes (PM-trigger eligibility and wakes, spare-order spawns, `wake_block`, the statistics reset).
| `raptor/core/engine/load.py` | Load a parsed `.rbd` file into the model objects a run consumes.
| `raptor/core/engine/model_checks.py` | Models the engine refuses to run, and shapes worth a warning.
| `raptor/core/engine/negative_draws.py` | The negative-time warning (`DrawNumber`).
| `raptor/core/engine/nodes.py` | Port of `RBDNodeObj.ReconfigureNode` (both halves) and `ChangeNodeState`.
| `raptor/core/engine/orchestrator.py` | The cascade: how one object's state change reaches everything else.
| `raptor/core/engine/phasing.py` | Port of `ControlPhaseChanges`/`ConductPhaseChange` — the phase-change scheduling loop and its per-object dispatcher.
| `raptor/core/engine/pool.py` | A FIFO give/take-back resource queue -- standard Modsim/SIMSCRIPT `RESOURCE` semantics (`WAIT FOR res TO Give(who, amount)` / `ASK res TO TakeBack(who, amount)`), which Raptor's own `PoolObj` (`PoolObj = OBJECT(ResourceObj)`) is built on. There is no Modsim source to port for the queueing mechanics themselves -- `ResourceObj` is a language-level built-in, not user Raptor code -- so this reproduces the standard semantics of that primitive instead: strict FIFO, head-of-line blocking (a later waiter whose smaller request could be satisfied right now still waits behind an earlier waiter whose larger request cannot -- no reordering, no skipping ahead).
| `raptor/core/engine/report_format.py` | Number-formatting helpers for the `End_Of_Run`/`Final_Results_Report` text output, ported line-for-line from Raptor 7. Pure string formatting, no engine state -- independently testable against hand-computed examples.
| `raptor/core/engine/reporting.py` | Per-run report-data snapshot for the `End_Of_Run`/`Final_Results` reports -- computed once per run from `SystemState`/`RBDBlock`, mirroring Raptor 7's per-run scalar computation (`StartEngine`, right after `ChangeStatus(DDone,NonMission)` ends the run). See `reports.py` for the text builders that consume this.
| `raptor/core/engine/reports.py` | `End_Of_Run` / `Final_Results_Report` text builders -- ports of `DoEndOfRunUpdate` and `DoEndOfSimUpdate`, covering the SUMMARY, LOGISTICS, SPARING, CAPACITY, COST, stock and weak-link sections. Sections with no fixture to verify them against raise `NotImplementedError` rather than being silently skipped.
| `raptor/core/engine/run_control.py` | Per-run reset performed at each new run's `SimTime=0.0` boundary.
| `raptor/core/engine/runner.py` | Run a model: the multi-run loop, the parallel batch and the report run.
| `raptor/core/engine/sim_details.py` | Port of `simDetails.TXT` (`/sd` flag) -- the exact value of every RNG draw, tagged by name and `SimTime`, that the Raptor 7 engine writes when launched with `/sd` (Raptor 7's `DrawNumber`, the single chokepoint every distribution call goes through):
| `raptor/core/engine/spf.py` | The Single Point Failure file's text layout and date (`WriteSPFfile`, menu 10-5).
| `raptor/core/engine/spf_fev.py` | `WriteSPFfile` run on Failure Effects View, as Raptor 7 does.
| `raptor/core/engine/stats.py` | `RunningStat`: a minimal Sum/Count/Min/Max accumulator matching the Modsim runtime's `RStatObj` (`StatMod`, a built-in statistics-monitor primitive with no source in this tree, like `TriggerObj`/`ResourceObj`). `RStatObj.StdDev` is population (N-divisor) standard deviation; `report_format.pop_to_sample` converts it where a displayed StDev/SEM column needs a sample value.
| `raptor/core/engine/step_session.py` | Step-through simulation for the GUI: one run advanced an event at a time.
| `raptor/core/engine/system_status.py` | Port of the system-level Green/Yellow/Red status aggregation: `AnalyzeSystem`'s color determination (the non-hierarchy/non-capacity-analysis subset) and `ChangeStatus` in full -- the `"System"`/`"State_change"` color line and the `"System"`/`"Phase_change"`/`"Began_a_mission"`/`"Finished_a_mission"` mission-transition lines.
| `raptor/core/engine/triggers.py` | Port of `RapTriggerObj.PullRapTrigger`.
| `raptor/core/engine/wait_sites.py` | The places an ordinary block's process can be woken.
| `raptor/core/engine/weak_metric.py` | The Raptor 7 Availability/Dependability weak-link ratio: one definition.
| `raptor/core/scheduler.py` | A minimal discrete-event scheduler — the Python analog of Modsim II's process-based `WAIT`/event-calendar semantics.
| `raptor/core/model.py` | Plain data model for Raptor 7's RBD objects.
| `raptor/core/rng.py` | Port of Raptor 7's random number generator (`RandomGenObj`).
|===
